coordination.ocha_plan: Escalation of Hostilities in the OPT Flash Appeal 2026
coordination.unhcr_plan: none (no UNHCR-led plan found; UNRWA separately serves Palestine refugees)
coordination.note: OCHA-coordinated Flash Appeal; UNRWA is a CWG contact organisation but its own appeal was not checked.

cwg_reliefweb.last_update_basis: Most recent dated item visible: calendar entry for a West Bank MPCA group meeting on 20 May 2026. Latest document posted on the page is 2024-07-02 (Gaza cash-for-work guidance); no updated stamp.
cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: A CANADEM OCHA vacancy says OCHA co-chairs the National CWG with Save the Children; the ReliefWeb page contacts block lists Action Against Hunger Spain, OCHA, UNRWA and WFP without stating roles (roles for the last three are inferred and the sources differ).
cwg_reliefweb.note: No in-country CVA dashboard on the page. The Gaza guiding note on mobile money and e-wallets (June 2024) is the latest CWG document found.

cva_delivered_usd.note: No total US$ delivered found. Gaza CWG note (Jun 2024): at least one emergency MPCA payment to over 178,000 households since 7 Oct 2023. UNICEF bulletin (Jun 2026): cumulatively about 1.3M people in about 213,000 families, no US$ total.

mpc_delivered_usd.note: UNICEF MPC reach given in people and families only.

fsps.name: PalPay
fsps.evidence: Gaza CWG note (Jun 2024): the vast majority of cash assistance was distributed via the PalPay agent network; UNICEF June 2026 bulletin says its digital cash is activated via PalPay/Jawwal Pay agents.

fsps.name: Jawwal Pay
fsps.evidence: UNICEF June 2026 bulletin cites PalPay/Jawwal Pay agents; UNDP/PAPP partnership (Sep 2024) names Jawwal Pay as digital payment partner.

fsps.name: Bank of Palestine
fsps.evidence: Gaza CWG note: PalPay agents accessed liquidity through Bank of Palestine ATMs and over-the-counter withdrawals; PalPay is a Bank of Palestine subsidiary per UNDP.
